title: Complete memory/context runtime

context.summary: Add runtime processing for session summaries and conservative memory derivation while keeping manual memory remember as the required active-memory path.
context.background: TASK-21 exposed job visibility and retry. The MVP now needs context to improve as sessions receive messages, without promoting automatic claims directly into active memory.

in: Add session summary update contracts and a Drizzle repository implementation.
Enqueue session.summarize and memory.derive jobs when messages are appended through the API runtime.
Register worker processors for session.summarize and memory.derive jobs.
Implement conservative memory derivation that only creates candidate claims with source references.
Keep manual memory remember as the only default active-memory creation path.
Update docs and validation scripts for memory/context runtime behavior.
out: Add LLM-backed summarization or memory extraction.
Automatically promote derived candidates to active memories.
Add UI review flows for candidate memories.

acceptance_criteria: DbSessionRepository persists updated session summaries and metadata.
Message append can enqueue session.summarize and memory.derive jobs when a dispatcher is wired.
Worker runtime registers processors for session.summarize and memory.derive.
Derived memory claims are created with status candidate and non-empty sourceRefs only.
Manual memory remember still defaults to active status.
ContextBuilder can consume updated session summaries through the existing ContextSessionRepository path.
Docs and validations describe the conservative derivation boundary.

manual_checks: Confirm derived memory claims are candidate, not active.
Confirm derived memory claims include sourceRefs.
Confirm manual memory remember still defaults to active.

risks: The MVP derivation is intentionally conservative and rule-based; richer extraction remains post-MVP.
Runtime behavior is structurally validated but still needs live E2E coverage in TASK-27.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
